target.source: V1 approved release: 71 static recipes plus reviewed pilot-30 and scale-399 batches
target.fingerprintMeaning: SHA-256 of ordered stable JSON projection of all RuntimeRecipe fields; excludes physical D1 line IDs, parent version/provenance, linked nutrition evidence, media rows and timestamps

recipeIdentity.authority: V1 release manifest exact 500 ordered recipe IDs

recipeMetadata.authority: V1 RuntimeRecipe projection and release fingerprint

ingredientSemanticIdentity.authority: V1 RuntimeRecipe ingredientId and name in each recipe; physical D1 line ID excluded

quantityUnit.authority: V1 requiredQuantity and closed standard unit in the release fingerprint

optionalFlag.authority: V1 isOptional true or absent/false in the release fingerprint

steps.authority: V1 ordered RuntimeRecipe step content in the release fingerprint

runtimeNutritionAsPresent.authority: V1 optional legacy nutrition macros as present in the release fingerprint

nutritionEvidenceForHardRestrictions.authority: Separate linked evidence and fail-closed T03/T20 eligibility, outside the runtime fingerprint

reconciliationRules.authority: Strict current diagnostic/refresh code predicates; committed V2 metadata yields zero cross-ID bridges

v1TargetIngredientOrder.authority: V1 ordered ingredient arrays, explicit 0034/0036/0037 positions and dated staging runtime fingerprint

runtimePositionAuthorityMeaning: No certified mapping from V1 target positions or V2 source-relative order to 6720 current production physical ingredient lines

reconciliationPolicy.sameId: Require recipe membership, ingredientId, quantity, unit, optional flag and approved name comparison; compare duplicate-preserving multisets
reconciliationPolicy.existingCanonicalIdBridge: Require nonempty distinct sourceId and canonicalId, resolution=existing_canonical_id and review=null
reconciliationPolicy.reviewedNewCanonicalIdBridge: Require nonempty sourceId, ING_ENR_ canonicalId, resolution=reviewed_new_canonical_id and exact review object with only nonempty basis and evidenceReference
prohibitedAsAuthority: cross-ID name/content similarity without a strict bridge
reconciliationPolicy.productionOnly: Classify relative to the named target; V2-relative aggregate production-only counts cannot be reused as V1 classifications. Without independently reviewed evidence use UNREVIEWED_PRODUCTION_ONLY
reconciliationPolicy.idConflict: ID_CONFLICT_RESOLVED only with a unique bridge passing the strict existing_canonical_id or reviewed_new_canonical_id predicate plus content tuple equality; otherwise ID_CONFLICT_REVIEW_REQUIRED
reconciliationPolicy.duplicateTuple: Multiplicity must match; semantic equality of duplicate tuples does not identify a unique physical row, so row mapping and position remain UNKNOWN

t21rb.scope: Design a read-only row-level semantic comparison against the certified V1 RuntimeRecipe projection; unresolved rows require MANUAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED
mayClassify: ingredient semantic ID and recipe membership
mustNotClassifyAsRepairDefect: current live ingredient position mismatch without a certified mapping
V2-relative production-only or cross-ID aggregate count treated as a V1 row result
cross-ID resemblance without a strict bridge
missing nutrition evidence inferred from runtime macros

unresolvedDimensions: authority of 6720 observed production physical ingredient-line IDs
runtime positions for those live lines
validity of V2-relative 1475 cross-ID content matches and 4649 production-only lines
current production steps, nutrition evidence and metadata coverage
T20 stored-composition and role impact of any future identity change
